# shc_rdns (Resource)

Manages reverse DNS (PTR record) for an IP address on an SHC VPS instance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address to set reverse DNS for.
- `service_id` (String) The SHC service ID of the VPS.

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) The FQDN to set as the PTR record.

### Read-Only

- `job_id` (String) The async job ID for the rDNS operation.
